name: Open Frequency
description: A weekly underground mesh broadcast structured as an open-call documentary collective — any verified contributor can submit footage, testimony, or technical knowledge for inclusion. Episodes have covered everything from corponation security patrol schedules to field-repair guides for damaged aug hardware to first-person accounts of forced relocation. The show has no fixed host, no central production node, and no address. It is the closest thing the Gray Zone has to a public record.
cultural_impact: Open Frequency established the distributed verification model that all subsequent underground journalism collectives in GLMZ have adopted as standard.
story_hooks: A new contributor has submitted footage that the verification collective cannot authenticate — but its contents, if real, would implicate a Tier 5 actor in a systematic crime.
One of the three wrongfully arrested contributors is still in detention; the collective has identified the Vantablack subsidiary responsible and is planning something that requires outside help.
A corporate intelligence team has successfully mapped three nodes of Open Frequency's distribution network — the collective doesn't know yet, and the window to warn them is closing.
